cohort: 746 women with twin pregnancies whose cervical length was measured by trans-vaginal ultrasonography at a mean of 22 weeks of gestation and who delivered in the study institution.
finding: Long cervical length at mid-pregnancy was an independent risk factor for cesarean section in women with twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: Long cervical length at mid-pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section in women with twin pregnancies.
gest_age: Included deliveries at late preterm or full term.
